title: Personal Sender Account Tenure Days in the Cash Pickup Correction Guarantee
content:
**Sender accounts note.** A recipient-name correction on a Cash Pickup transfer guarantees the recipient a number of days of collection, called the correction guarantee. Tenure days are added to it. They follow the sender's Personal Sender Account whose status is active, and they turn on the account's level and its months open together. Months open are the whole calendar months from the opening date to the day of the correction.

| Personal Sender Account (active) | Days added to the correction guarantee |
|---|---|
| open at least 24 months, level Paloma Enhanced, Paloma Premier or Paloma Private Client | 6 |
| open at least 12 months, level Paloma Verified or Paloma Verified Plus | 3 |
| any other account | none |

## Combinations (hypothetical accounts)

| Level | Whole months open | Days |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Premier | 25 | 6 |
| Paloma Premier | 18 | none (short of 24 months; the 12-month row is for Paloma Verified and Paloma Verified Plus only) |
| Paloma Verified | 14 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 6 | none |
| Paloma Starter | 36 | none |
